notes.title: Star Racer 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
It’s official. We’re finally at our 1.0 release!!!



Star Racer really would not be what it is today without so much help and support from so many people. Thank you to the many talented musicians who helped create an incredible soundtrack. Thank you to all the engineers who helped translate our design vision into reality. Thank you to all the artists who helped bring this world and these characters to life. Thank you to our friends and family for their unwavering and unending support. Thank you to our Kickstarter backers who put faith into this project when it was just a fledgling demo.




I have a couple of house keeping notes I also want to mention.



Updated Price: 
In case you missed our previous announcement, the new official price of the game is $9.99. All Kickstarter backers who backed the project at the original price will be receiving a copy of Soundtrack at no additional cost.



Steam Racing Fest: 
We are a part of this sale and are providing a 20% discount, making the game $7.99 for first-time buyers. The sale will be active for 2 weeks.



Kickstarter Perks: 
There are two remaining perks that are still work-in-progress: The Soundtrack and the Kickstarter Vehicle Color Palette. Now that we’ve made the 1.0 release we can now return to working on these perks. We will update you all with release dates soon. Make sure to join our Discord as we provide more in-progress updates there! Besides these two, all of the other perks have been completed — including the Credits, which you can find under Collections in the main menu.



Demo: 
We have updated the demo! So if you are still unsure, but want to rock out to a few tracks by Grant Kirkhope, Mason Lieberman, and Jules Conroy... (and myself) while testing out the driving mechanics, give the new demo a try! You can even compete on the death race leaderboards.



Final Thoughts:
It feels so good that we were able to get to this day. But this 1.0 release is just the beginning. We have planned work to fix bugs and optimize the game. There are many more features we want to bring to Star Racer (yes, including online multiplayer), more platforms we want to be on. We will be actively reaching out to more partners and publishers to make Star Racer as great as it can be. 




And this is just the beginning of Whatnot Games. There are so many types of games we want to make, and we are so thankful that so many of you have already joined us on our journey. We hope that you’ll continue to watch us as we try to make games that we wished existed in the world.




So please spread the word. Leave reviews (good or bad, but preferably good!). And report bugs. It’s time to get to work. See you on the track, racers!



-- Brennan Anderson

notes.title: Star Racer Major Update v0.8.1
notes.notes:
Steam Workshop Integration
Let's get right to the biggest part of this update; Steam Workshop Integration. We have put in a lot of work making sure that the workshop integration is as seamless as possible for players. 



It starts off in the course editor. Once you make a track, you must complete one lap on the test track to make sure that the course is completable. Then you may upload to the workshop straight from the editor screen. You may also make changes and update your workshop item at any time (you have to complete one lap any time you make a change!). Once the course is uploaded, you will get the workshop info panel on the left. You may then open the steam overlay to make any changes to the item description.



In the course select screen, you have the option to open the workshop in the Steam overlay. This is how you can browse and subscribe to other player's courses! The new courses should download very quickly (the largest file size I've seen is less than half a MB), and the course will appear in the carousel as soon as it is downloaded.

So, give the workshop a try! Show people what you can make, challenge your friends, or troll them with devious courses. Have fun pushing the course editor o its limits! Every official course that we made in the game was made using the exact same tools in the course editor. It was very important to me that anything we can make, the players can make too. There are no hidden developer features in terms of what you can create in the editor.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/58d3915c42b46f9f0f257debe304e96a848d864a.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/032499a0f63503dbc182db5297cd6f355931f2e8.png"][/carousel]Version Number Readjustment
Ok, so I was really bad at estimating how long things would take and what features constituted a major/minor/patch version. That was my bad. But, no time like the present to correct that. We have updated the version number to 0.8.1 at the time of this writing. 0.8 is the inclusion of Steam Workshop integration, and we patched it with some minor bug fixes. On our roadmap, we have one more major feature planned for the 0.9.0 release, then a bunch of polish/tuning/bug fixes before we get to the 1.0.0 version. We are nearing the end!


Features/Tuning Changes

Accessibility Settings
This one has been a long time coming, and I was finally able to dedicate some time to it. All of the settings aren't completed, but two major features are done, and those are the one hand modes and auto acceleration. 


Auto Acceleration
Auto acceleration is fairly self-explanatory, it allows you not to have to worry about holding the acceleration button. Braking overrides acceleration, and tapping acceleration still performs drift boosts.


One Hand Mode
This was inspired by my cousin who broke his hand and was having a hard time playing the game. It reinforced the idea that many disabilities are temporary, and that shouldn't preclude you from enjoying a game. One Hand Mode does what it says, it allows you to play the game with one hand. There are some drawbacks to that, as we are using most of the buttons on the controller already, but I think it works well enough. 



Type 1 maps the acceleration and braking to up and down on the right analogue stick with pressing in to boost. Attacks are on the shoulder buttons. Strafing is on the face buttons.



Type 2 maps the acceleration and braking to the shoulder buttons. Strafing and attacks are on the face buttons.



Both types will side dash and spin in the direction you are turning. Both types are ambidextrous, so you can play with either hand since controllers are for the most part pretty symmetrical.



When you combine One Hand Mode, Auto Acceleration, and options to invert both horizontal and vertical axes, my hope is that there are powerful and robust enough accessibility settings so that anybody can play this game.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/80c63dbf12c8bc8b66cee2d9de4048fd863ce3fc.png"]
Rank Badges
I think the game was really missing some incentives to play the different game modes. Sure they are fun, and yes you unlock characters by doing them, but it wasn't feeling sticky enough. So now we have added rank badges that you can collect for doing well on most game modes. They will be prominently displayed with that game mode. This includes Grand Prix, Time Trials, Death Race, and Event Races. Now you can collect as many S-Rank Badges as you can and show them off to friends! There is some light shaming involved too. You can get down to a D-Rank if you don't do particularly well. We opted not to give an F-Rank at least!


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/02bd84a1d07abf6c6fedd2638e560b708827581b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/f1e7250e42a9cf32655375807351fd612f163b19.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/7141f6365e9fde07fb996b7cb1499d5b7f24cddf.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44679155/89897a8c4f0c40a64c2414f8d7a31bc63e504c4e.png"][/carousel]

Other Features
Here is a short list of the other notable features we have added:

Boost Checkpoints. Now on point-to-point races, you can add a boost checkpoint. This will enable the boost power for the rest of the race.

Tons of new VO from our announcer! Including all the characters, and some in-race flavor lines!

Precision Boost Pads. There is a new boost pad type that will rotate your vehicle to orient in the direction of the boost pad.

Boost Chaining. Boosts are now more technical, as they don't automatically put you up to your top speed anymore. They dow increase your speed a bit, but not as fast. So to get to your top speed quickly you have to chain multiple boosts together. When hitting a boost pad after you already manually boosted, you will get to the top speed even faster, and every time you hit another boost pad before your previous boost runs out, your max boost speed will increase a bit. This will let you reach super high speeds on some courses if you have the skill to hit all of the boost pads.

Allowing retry in every game mode, including event races.

Added Wildlands course (Designed by Silent Fox).

Added Planet Core course (Designed by Silent Fox).

At least 10 unlock-able color palettes for each character.


Bug Fixes
Too many to count, like seriously. My work style is that I fix bugs as fast as I make them. So as many features are in the game, many more than that amount of bugs have been fixed. Here are a few notable ones though.



Fixed mouse cursor not clicking on buttons in the course editor when using Mouse and Keyboard controls (that was a fun one)

Fixed tutorials freezing on start.

Fixed not being able to lock on to targets and turrets

Fixed homing laser rapidly spinning around you infinitely

Fixed wind not rendering properly

That's about it for this update! As always, please feel free to give any feedback on Steam, or on our discord.

notes.title: Star Racer 4.1 Update
notes.notes:
Hey all! We've been super hard at work on Star Racer, and we have a pretty big update for you all! 

This update includes tons of balancing changes, bug fixes, and polish updates.

Features

 Time Trials: They are now basically complete! You can race to record your ghosts, and your fastest times will be uploaded to the steam leaderboards. Your best times will also be saved and counted towards unlocks for some characters.
 Supernova maneuver: If you manually boost immediately after executing a drift boost, you will perform a supernova. This is a huge boost in speed, and it will drop a mine behind your vehicle, damaging any other vehicle who drives through it. Be careful though, it takes a lot of energy.
 First Place Bombing: If you are in first place, towards the end of the race, the authorities want you to lose, so they will start shooting bombs at you! Avoid them at all costs if you want to win!
 Added a new track called Frozen Corkscrew.


Balance Changes

 Luca has slower top speed, but much faster boosts.
 Neon has much faster boosts, but they have dramatically slower durations
 Zhara has much slower top speed, but her speed scales better with capsules. At full capsules, she is one of the faster vehicles, but at no capsules she is one of the slowest.
 Automaton accelerates extremely fast, but also stops extremely fast as well, making it's movement all or nothing.


Bug Fixes

 Allow you to retry in the middle of time trials and quick races now works.
 Fixed vehicles not exiting flight mode when touching the track sometimes.
 Fixed vehicles getting stuck in geometry when impacting them at high speeds.
 Music now properly plays when returning to the menu.
 Dialogue no longer carries over between races.
 Fixed braking during starting boost causing vehicle to stop immediately.
 Fixed sprites flickering at some angles.


Please help us out by checking out the changes and letting us know what you think. We are in the home stretch, and want this game to be as much fun as possible! Please note that not all of the content is finished. We still have a few more tracks to build, and lots of event races to complete.

Thank you all!

notes.title: Game Update Nov. 23rd
notes.notes:
Star Racer Development - Game Update

Hey Racers! 🚀

We’ve been working hard to improve Star Racer and we’re happy to announce that we’re updating the main branch TODAY. Here's a quick breakdown of everything we’ve been up to over the past few months and what we plan to do soon:

Revamped Systems and UI Overhaul

 Complete input and UI system revamp.
 New Radial menus for Track Editor
 New player profiles UI/UX for customized settings.
 Event and Trigger system allowing for challenges and event races


Visual Updates and Features

 New color palettes for more vibrant visuals.
 Event Races and unlockables for deeper gameplay experiences.
 Character and Music Gallery to enjoy in-game dossiers and tracks you’ve discovered. 🎶


Still Under Construction
There are many things that are not yet final and still under construction. We ask for your patience as the content is being worked on. This includes, but is not limited to:

 Game Modes and Event Races
 Unlock conditions
 Bounties screen
 Gallery screen
 Character comics
 SNES style versions of music tracks
 New courses
 Grand Prixs
 Various bugs during races


A Personal Note
In September, I celebrated my wedding! Took a short break to celebrate and recover. Back in full swing and ready to bring exciting updates to Star Racer.

Looking Ahead
Continuing to develop new content:

 New tracks and event races.
 New music.
 More vehicle palettes and other unlockables
 More Accessibility options


We’re always open to feedback and questions—let us know if you’d like sneak peeks of what’s next. Also, if you want to be one of the first to hear about updates, we’re the most active on our Discord and tend to share updates there more regularly!

Thanks for your patience and support. We’re committed to making Star Racer the best it can be and can’t wait to see you on the track! 🏁

-The Star Racer Team

notes.title: Star Racer Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody!

Early Access
Star Racer is releasing into Early Access! Why? Well, we want to get it out to as many people as possible, and we want to listen and incorporate as much feedback as we can. From vehicle tuning and difficulty settings to courses and unlock conditions, we want to know what you think, and take steps to make Star Racer as good as it possibly can be. We will also be using this time to finish developing the content and remaining game modes that will make Star Racer feel complete and super fun!

Bugs
During development there are bound to be a few bugs and issues present. We have created a bug tracking spreadsheet so that you can be aware of all the known issues in the game. If you would like to report a bug, you can do so on the Steam forums, or respond to the following google form. You can also head over to the Discord server to discuss any issues as well.

Bug Tracking Spreadsheet

Bug Reporting Form

Join the Discord Server to discuss bugs/issues

I am super excited to bring Star Racer to everybody. I love games, and I want to give people some fun and excitement through games. Happy racing!

💫Star Racer Forever!💫

-Brennan

The Kickstarter campaign has ended and was a huge success! We raised 144% of what we were asking, hitting some stretch goals along the way! What does this mean for Star Racer? Well a few things:


 The vehicle/character roster will be expanded to at least 20 playable characters at launch.

In addition to those two major pieces of news, we also conducted a community poll over on the Discord to select a few of the racers that will be added. I am so proud that we have such an active and growing community around this game!
